title: YPTI
bottom_line: Germany's toolcraft AG says it bought 50% of YPTI, a Kalasan (Sleman) precision-parts and mould maker founded in 1999, in August 2023 after a 2021 joint-venture MoU, and put its founder Bernd Krebs and CFO Marc Volkhardt on YPTI's supervisory board; Petrus Tedja Hapsoro runs YPTI as president director (confirmed by press). YPTI also builds the Joglo VF-500i CNC machining centre (TKDN 46.34%), and Kemenperin confirms it is authorized to build and maintain Taiwanese maker Chi-Fa's Twinhorn machines, with PT Pumatech as Chi-Fa's dealer; PT Indotech Trimitra Abadi sells the Joglo as a separate distributor with its own founders, not as a parent or sister company. The main named customer deal is a 12 Mar 2025 framework with PTDI to supply and revitalise PTDI's old machines; it is confirmed, but no order value or aircraft-part sale to PTDI is public. Other confirmed partners are UGM (GeNose C19 parts, Venindo ventilator, MoU), Kemenperin (visits, Hannover Messe, the 2026 IKM matchmaking) and Toyota's TMMIN (2020 ventilator); YPTI also makes Toyota Sienta Welcab brackets, but the buyer is not named.

entities.name: YPTI
entities.legal_name: PT Yogya Presisi Teknikatama Industri (TKDN and Kemenperin directory spelling: PT Yogya Presisi Tehnikatama Industri)
entities.what: Precision-parts, mould and plastic-injection maker founded 1999 (toolcraft's history says 1998); AS9100; builds the Joglo VF-500i CNC machining centre and, per Kemenperin, is authorized to build and maintain Chi-Fa's Twinhorn machines; 50% owned by toolcraft AG since Aug 2023 (toolcraft's claim); Kemenperin directory KBLI 22293.

entities.name: Joglo VF-500i
entities.what: 3-axis CNC vertical machining centre (X/Y/Z 500/380/400 mm, 12,000 rpm, BT30, 20 tools, Mitsubishi M80) with a batik motif; TKDN 46.34% on Kemenperin's register under YPTI (Indotech's page says 44.19%); most likely a locally built Twinhorn VF-500 (inference).

entities.name: YPTS
entities.what: Separate company in Kemenperin's directory with the same 'Yogya Presisi Teknikatama' name (KBLI 29300, motor-vehicle parts); ypts.co.id is a coming-soon page. No ownership source.

entities.name: toolcraft AG
entities.what: Family-owned German precision-parts maker founded 1989 by Bernd Krebs (CNC machining, additive manufacturing, moulds, robotics); 495 staff; lists Yogyakarta among its sites; holds 50% of YPTI since Aug 2023.

entities.name: Toolcraft Wohlrab Ltd.
entities.what: Injection-moulding joint venture of toolcraft and Wohlrab founded in 2016 (toolcraft history); toolcraft's other Asian venture, no YPTI tie found.

entities.name: unicam Software
entities.what: CAD/CAM software house (hyperMILL, CIMCO) 'since 1992'; toolcraft's history says Bernd Krebs founded unicam in 1992.

entities.name: Unicam Indonesia
entities.what: Shared a booth with Indotech and YPTI at Manufacturing Indonesia 2023 (Jakarta, 6-9 Dec 2023); legal name and owner not found.

entities.name: Chi-Fa Machinery (Twinhorn)
entities.what: Taiwanese CNC machine-tool builder selling under the TWINHORN brand (history from 1976; high-speed VF series since 2006); lists Indonesia in its sales network without naming a dealer.

entities.name: PT Pumatech
entities.what: Named by detikFinance (Mar 2025) as Chi-Fa's authorized dealer in Indonesia that will support YPTI's maintenance of Twinhorn machines; no website, address or register entry found.

entities.name: Mitsubishi Electric (CNC controls)
entities.what: Maker of the M80 CNC controller listed in the Joglo VF-500i's TKDN specification; supply route not stated.

entities.name: Indotech Group
entities.city: Sidoarjo (Surabaya office) and Surakarta; also Cikarang, Balikpapan
entities.what: Industrial-tooling distributor since 2010 (cutting tools, CNC machines, CAD/CAM) and maker of Pratter coffee roasters (TKDN 34.61%); licensed Twinhorn distributor; sells the Joglo VF-500i; Kemenperin directory KBLI 10761. Founders 'Heru, Agung dan Nofan'.

entities.name: PTDI
entities.what: State aircraft maker; signed a framework agreement with YPTI on 12 Mar 2025 to supply and revitalise its 15+-year-old production machines and train maintenance staff.

entities.name: INACOM
entities.what: Aircraft-component makers' association; Kemenperin says some N219 parts are made by its members and names YPTI with PTDI in its AS9100 supply-chain sentence; YPTI membership not confirmed.

entities.name: Kemenperin
entities.what: Ministry of Industry: TKDN register for the Joglo; facilitated the YPTI-toolcraft MoU (Hannover Messe 2021); ministers visited YPTI (2017, 2021); hosted the PTDI-YPTI framework signing (2025); put YPTI in its 2026 metal-IKM matchmaking.

entities.name: BBKKP Yogyakarta
entities.legal_name: Balai Besar Kulit, Karet dan Plastik (Kemenperin)
entities.what: Kemenperin leather, rubber and plastics centre; made GeNose C19 rubber gaskets and plugs in the UGM-led consortium and developed a non-rebreathing-mask sample bag with YPTI (Feb 2021).

entities.name: UGM
entities.what: University; led the GeNose C19 consortium and the Venindo ventilator project with YPTI as hardware partner (2020-21); MoU with its vocational mechanical-engineering department (2018); theses at YPTI (2017, 2022); physics department visit (Apr 2026).

entities.name: PT Swayasa Prakarsa
entities.what: Partner on UGM's Venindo ventilators and holder of their distribution permits (UGM, 2022); GeNose assembly, permits and QC per a search summary.

entities.name: PT Stechoq Robotika Indonesia
entities.what: Partner on UGM's Venindo ventilators (UGM, 2022); GeNose pneumatics per a search summary.

entities.name: TMMIN (Toyota)
entities.what: Toyota's Indonesian manufacturing arm; in Apr 2020 partnered YPTI and its component suppliers on raw materials for the UGM-YPTI ventilator.

entities.name: Toyota-Astra Motor
entities.what: Toyota's Indonesian distributor; launched the Sienta Welcab in 2020 (snippet). YPTI makes the Welcab's bracket parts, but no source names YPTI's buyer.

entities.name: SMKs in Yogyakarta (9, unnamed)
entities.what: YPTI's GM said in Nov 2017 that at least nine Yogyakarta vocational schools are under YPTI's guidance and that it takes SMK interns; the schools are not named.

entities.name: Petrus Tedja Hapsoro
entities.what: Managing Director (2021, 2023) and Direktur Utama (2025) of YPTI; signed the 2021 toolcraft MoU and the 12 Mar 2025 PTDI framework agreement.

entities.name: Ariyono Wibowo
entities.what: General Manager of YPTI in Nov 2017; current role unknown.

entities.name: Christoph Hauck
entities.what: toolcraft executive board member (Chief Officer Technology/Sales); signed the 2021 MoU with YPTI; joined YPTI's technical management team in Aug 2023.

entities.name: Bernd Krebs
entities.what: Founder of toolcraft (1989) and unicam (1992); chairman of toolcraft's supervisory board; joined YPTI's supervisory board in Aug 2023.

entities.name: Marc Volkhardt
entities.what: toolcraft CFO (executive board); joined YPTI's supervisory board in Aug 2023.

entities.name: Antonius Agung Nugroho
entities.what: Director (Direktur) of PT Indotech Trimitra Abadi (Oct 2023); likely the 'Agung' among Indotech's three founders (name match; a Kompas snippet calls 'Antonius Agung' the founder).

entities.name: Dena Hendriana
entities.what: PTDI Production Director; signed the framework agreement with YPTI on 12 Mar 2025.

entities.name: Setia Diarta
entities.what: Director General of ILMATE at Kemenperin; explained PTDI's choice of YPTI (Twinhorn authorization, Pumatech support) and witnessed the FA (12 Mar 2025).

entities.name: Agus Gumiwang Kartasasmita
entities.what: Minister of Industry; visited YPTI with Coordinating Minister Luhut B. Pandjaitan on 19 May 2021 and met toolcraft in Munich on 28 Oct 2021 about the YPTI joint venture.

links.detail: Bought a 50% stake (release of 15 Aug 2023: 'acquiring a 50% stake in PT. YPTI was the logical next step'), tied to YPTI's succession planning; gives toolcraft its Asian production base. Remaining owners not named.

2021 MoU signed by YPTI MD Petrus Tedja Hapsoro and toolcraft board member Christoph Hauck (CNC machining, additive manufacturing, robotics, injection moulding), facilitated by Kemenperin at Hannover Messe 2021 as a joint-venture scheme.
toolcraft's history lists '1998 Foundation of YPTI' ('personal relationships with Indonesia led to the foundation') and says the two have worked closely since; it does not say who founded YPTI.
Founded toolcraft in 1989; the release calls it a medium-sized family-owned company.
Chairman of toolcraft AG's supervisory board since the 2020 change to an AG.
Joined PT YPTI's supervisory board (read as Dewan Komisaris) with the Aug 2023 stake.
toolcraft's history: Bernd Krebs founded the software company unicam in 1992.
Chief Financial Officer, member of the executive board.
Joined PT YPTI's supervisory board with the Aug 2023 stake.
Chief Technology and Sales Officer, member of the executive board.
Joined PT YPTI's technical management team in Aug 2023 alongside his toolcraft role; earlier signed the 2021 MoU for toolcraft.
Joint venture with Wohlrab founded in 2016 in Singapore (injection-moulding centre); toolcraft's other Asian venture.
Direktur Utama; signed the PTDI framework agreement (12 Mar 2025). Called managing director in 2021 and in toolcraft's 2023 release.
General Manager; spoke at Minister Airlangga Hartarto's visit on 14 Nov 2017 about SMK interns.
Same 'Yogya Presisi Teknikatama' name, separate Kemenperin directory entry (KBLI 29300 motor-vehicle parts vs YPTI's 22293); probably a sister company, but no ownership source.
Kemenperin's TKDN register lists PT Yogya Presisi Tehnikatama Industri as the company for the 'Joglo VF-500i' CNC milling machine at 46.34% (register read 16 Oct 2026; no certificate date shown).
Calls itself the distributor of the Joglo VF-500i, 'made in Yogyakarta with our production partner PT YPTI'; its product page lists TKDN 44.19% (register: 46.34%) and no price.
Calls YPTI its 'partner produksi'; shared a booth with YPTI and Unicam Indonesia at Manufacturing Indonesia 2023 (6-9 Dec) showing a 5-axis Twinhorn VF-500 5A. No shared owners or directors found.
Says it is 'salah satu pemegang lisensi distributor resmi Twinhorn di Indonesia' and sells Twinhorn VTG and VE machines.
Direktur of PT Indotech Trimitra Abadi, quoted at Trade Expo Indonesia 2023.
Indotech lists founders 'Heru, Agung dan Nofan' (Mar 2021); a Kompas snippet names founder 'Antonius Agung'; matching the two is a name match only.
Shared the Manufacturing Indonesia 2023 booth with Indotech and YPTI (Indotech's account).
Same name as Bernd Krebs's unicam CAD/CAM firm and appears next to toolcraft-linked YPTI; no source says it is unicam's Indonesian arm.
DG ILMATE Setia Diarta: YPTI has the 'kemampuan dan otorisasi' to design, produce, assemble and maintain Twinhorn CNC machines made by Chi-Fa (Taiwan); the reason PTDI chose YPTI.
YPTI's machine list shows Twinhorn VE-1020L3, VF-700, VF-500, VTH-1055L3 and HE-400 machines (2019-2020, Mitsubishi controls).
Design basis: shares the Twinhorn VF-500 model name; Indotech tags the Joglo 'twinhorn'; read as a locally built Twinhorn VF-500. No source states it.
Authorized dealer of Chi-Fa Machinery Manufacturer in Indonesia.
Will support YPTI's maintenance service for the Twinhorn CNC machines in the PTDI deal.
TKDN spec: 'Controller : Mitsubishi CNC M80'; whether bought direct, via Chi-Fa or via a dealer is not stated.

Framework agreement signed 12 Mar 2025 at Kemenperin: supply and revitalisation of PTDI production machines, machining competitiveness, maintenance-management training. No order value or delivery published.
Aircraft components: not confirmed. Wamenperin only hopes the tie goes beyond 'revitalisasi, penyediaan komponen dan pemeliharaan'; no named PTDI part order to YPTI found.
Production Director (Direktur Produksi); signed the FA with YPTI. PTDI President Director Gita Amperiawan witnessed.
Kemenperin's 2025 release names YPTI and PTDI in its sentence on INACOM firms with AS9100 in the global supply chain; YPTI's membership is not confirmed.

Facilitated the YPTI-toolcraft joint venture at Hannover Messe 2021; Minister Agus Gumiwang met toolcraft in Munich on 28 Oct 2021 about it. YPTI was also at Hannover Messe 2023 with Kemenperin (snippet).
Ministers visited YPTI: Airlangga Hartarto (14 Nov 2017, SMK link-and-match) and Agus Gumiwang with Luhut B. Pandjaitan (19 May 2021, P3DN local-products programme).
Hosted the PTDI-YPTI framework signing (12 Mar 2025), witnessed by Deputy Minister Faisol Riza and DG ILMATE Setia Diarta.
Ditjen IKMA's metal-IKM matchmaking (29-30 Jul 2026): YPTI joined field visits to IKM in Karawang and Bekasi and spoke at the 30 Jul business meeting (with PTPN, Hitachi CM, Sarandi, UT Pandu).
Director General of ILMATE (metal, machinery, transport equipment, electronics).
Minister of Industry; visited YPTI (19 May 2021) and met toolcraft in Munich (28 Oct 2021).
BBKKP is a Kemenperin technical centre (satker) in Yogyakarta.
GeNose C19: worked with YPTI in the UGM-led consortium, made rubber gaskets and plugs; YPTI asked it to develop a non-rebreathing-mask sample bag to cut costs.
GeNose C19: 'PT. YPTI berperan pada produksi komponen mekanik dan plastik pada GeNose C19', developed with UGM.
Ventilator: UGM brought in YPTI as 'project integrator, prototyping, dan hardware developer' (Apr 2020); UGM later lists YPTI among partners of the Venindo V-01 and R-03.
MoU partner of UGM's vocational Mechanical Engineering department (listed 31 Jul 2018); UGM theses at YPTI in 2017 and 2022.
UGM Physics department visit on 30 Apr 2026 to explore collaboration; no MoU mentioned.
Co-partner on UGM's Venindo ventilators (Swayasa holds the distribution permits); GeNose assembler while YPTI made the mechanics, per a search summary.
Co-partner on UGM's Venindo ventilators; GeNose pneumatics per a search summary.

2020 ventilator: 'PT YPTI bermitra dengan PT Toyota Motor Manufacturing Indonesia (TMMIN) dan pemasok komponennya' for raw materials; Menperin said Toyota would invest if reverse-engineering worked (snippet).
YPTI makes bracket (rotation-plate) parts for the Toyota Sienta Welcab (UGM thesis 2022; Kemenperin 2021 lists 'welcab Toyota Sienta'); TAM sells the Welcab, but no source names YPTI's buyer.
Takes SMK interns; GM said at least nine Yogyakarta SMKs are under YPTI's guidance and teacher internships were planned.
